::: {#def-ppp-value}
#### Posterior predictive p-value

The **posterior predictive p-value** of a [test quantity](#def-test-quantity) $T$
is the posterior probability that a replicated data set
gives a value of $T$ at least as large as the observed data do:

$$
p_B = \Prf{T(\vY^{\mathrm{rep}}) \ge T(\vy) \mid \vy},
$$

where the probability is over $\param$ drawn from its [posterior](#def-posterior)
and $\vY^{\mathrm{rep}}$ drawn from the model given $\param$
[@gelman2013bda, Section 6.3, p. 146].
:::
